_source: Voteview (voteview.com, Lewis et al.) member exports, Senate and House, Congresses 101-119, retrieved 2026-10-03; regenerate with backend/scripts/calibrate_position_confidence.py
_method: Members with positions in adjacent Congresses, each read from the party's center toward its flank: least squares of full = drift * n / (n + n0) * thin over pairs with a thin side (under 200 scaled votes) and pairs of full records, both chambers, with log n0 linear in the thin Congress's party-line share; each chamber's half_weight_votes is n0 at the sitting Congress's share, clamped to the middle 90% of the thin pairs' shares; uncounted_weight_recent is the weight of positions with no count since the 110th Congress, which the score reads as 0 votes; intervals are 5th-95th percentiles over members resampled
